title: DiceRoll
tagline: Simple Farcaster Frame built on Arbitrum where you pay to dice a roll and you win the higher number you get.

prizes.placement: Best use of Blockscout Block Explorer
prizes.title: Best use of Blockscout Block Explorer

description: The project is pretty simple. On Farcaster Frame you press a button and send a transaction of 0.0001 ETH on Arbitrum. Then the randomly generated number from 1 to 6 appears and you get your stake back proportionally the higher number you get. If you get 1 - you get nothing, you get 6 - you get 0.000199 ETH back, etc.
how_its_made:
It's a Farcaster Frame built using frog-ui on Arbitrum chain with Blockscout contract verification. Everything was pretty simple and straight-forward. I like how I took the pictures of a dice roll dynamic sticker from Telegram and added them to my project.

The game has very nice UI and pretty easy to play - press button to play. The formula to calculate the win or loose has advantage for contract of 1% more or less like in casino.
